parties.counterparty: SFG Financial Corp, a/k/a E-Path FX (Licensor/Vendor)

plans.note: All-caps disclaimer block (Article VIX) very likely continues into a damages exclusion/cap; check sec-p0112/sec-p0116 and any cap language carried into Article X or the general provisions. Confirm mutuality and carve-outs for IP indemnity, confidentiality breach and willful misconduct.

No indemnity heading in the outline; a warranty-disclaimer-heavy licensor form often omits vendor IP indemnity entirely. Verify general provisions and confidentiality article before adding a vendor-side IP/misconduct indemnity.

Article II licence restrictions and the confidentiality/non-solicitation article (sec-p0123) are the likely homes for any restraint on our building or buying competing FX platforms; also scan Article VIII where the Right of First Refusal sits.
The defined term 'Right of First Refusal' signals an exclusivity-style restraint, likely in Article VIII with its definition in Article I; confirm we remain free to source other platforms.
No pricing-parity language evident; check the per-Market Day fee tiers and Supplemental Payments terms for any obligation running against us before concluding absence.

Heading 'CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION' confirms a non-solicit; check whether it binds us (likely mutual or one-way against Licensee), its duration, scope and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

Term/termination provisions most likely in Article VIII (which carries the Initial Period and payment mechanics) with survival in general provisions; confirm we have notice-based exit without penalty and that Licensor cannot terminate at will mid-term.
'Initial Period' is a defined term, so the renewal mechanic sits in Article I and the term provisions of Article VIII; check notice window length and any uncapped fee escalation on renewal.
Governing law, venue and any arbitration clause will be in the GENERAL PROVISIONS block; verify the forum is an accepted jurisdiction and that disputes go to courts rather than offshore arbitration.

Assignment/successors clause expected in general provisions; also check Article II restrictions and the AFFILIATE definition so we retain affiliate/successor assignment and Licensor cannot terminate on our change of control.

Ownership turns on the LICENSED TECHNOLOGY/DERIVATIVE WORK/MORAL RIGHTS definitions in Article I and the acknowledgements in Article II; confirm no assignment of our data, trade flow information or feedback to Licensor.

Grant and restrictions are in Article II with FIELD OF USE, PLATFORM SOFTWARE and AFFILIATE defined in Article I; check the grant is not revocable at will and extends to our affiliates and contractors.

Licence-verification or records/audit rights, if present, will sit with the Article II restrictions or in general provisions; if found, tighten to annual, notified, off-site-where-possible and at Licensor's cost.

No penalty heading visible; review the fee-tier table, 'Supplemental Payments' definition and Article VIII payment terms for shortfall charges, interest or accelerated-fee provisions functioning as liquidated damages against us.

Article VIX is a broad all-caps WARRANTY DISCLAIMER (merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, no assurance of correction); we need an affirmative performance/documentation-conformance warranty with a repair-or-refund remedy.
No insurance heading in the outline; since Licensor hosts the Platform and touches our trading data, confirm absence in general provisions and then add standard coverages including cyber/tech E&O.

The volume-tier pricing table plus 'Market Day', 'Initial Period' and 'Supplemental Payments' definitions suggest a minimum/take-or-pay structure; confirm any committed volume has a shortfall-only remedy and an exit.

No wind-down heading; check the termination consequences in Article VIII and the confidentiality return-of-materials language, which may require deletion rather than return of our data — we need export, return and transition assistance.
